literal_meaning: বোধের শোধ বা অনুসন্ধান (sense's search or purification)
figurative_meaning_en: common sense; intellectual discernment; purity of intellect
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বোধশোধ খুবই স্পষ্ট, তাই সে সবসময় সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়।
বোধশোধের অভাবে সে ভুল পথে চলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His bodhshodh is very clear, so he always makes the right decisions.
Due to a lack of bodhshodh, he went down the wrong path.
note: This appears to be a compound term emphasizing mental clarity, rooted in classical Bengali linguistic traditions.
